# `satl compose` { #satl-compose }

Deploy a Compose file as cluster services (stack semantics, not `docker compose`'s).

`satl compose up` creates one *service* per compose service on a shared
overlay network, scheduled across the whole cluster -- the semantics of
`docker stack deploy`, not of `docker compose`, because SatL has no
standalone containers: every container is a task of a service.

Services are named <project>_<service> and answer to the compose service
name as a DNS alias, so the hostnames inside the file keep working. The
project name comes from -p, else `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`, else the file's
`name:`, else the directory; `down` removes exactly the objects `up`
labelled with it, and nothing else.

Anything outside the supported subset is refused with the file, the
service and the key named, never silently ignored. The subset and every
deviation are in docs/api-compat.md (entries 110-124).

```console
$ satl compose [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

`satl compose` is a group: it always takes one of the subcommands below.

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-f, --file &lt;FILE&gt;</code> | Compose file to read; found by walking up from the working directory when not given |
| <code>-p, --project-name &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Project name (default: the project directory's name, normalized) |
| <code>--project-directory &lt;DIR&gt;</code> | Directory `env_file` paths and the default project name come from |

## `satl compose up` { #satl-compose-up }

Create or update the stack's networks and services

```console
$ satl compose up [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-d, --detach</code> | Accepted for compatibility: `up` never attaches, so it is always detached (there is no cluster-wide log stream yet) |
| <code>-f, --file &lt;FILE&gt;</code> | Compose file to read; found by walking up from the working directory when not given |
| <code>-p, --project-name &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Project name (default: the project directory's name, normalized) |
| <code>--remove-orphans</code> | Remove services of this project that the file no longer declares |
| <code>--project-directory &lt;DIR&gt;</code> | Directory `env_file` paths and the default project name come from |

## `satl compose down` { #satl-compose-down }

Remove the services and networks this project created

```console
$ satl compose down [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-f, --file &lt;FILE&gt;</code> | Compose file to read; found by walking up from the working directory when not given |
| <code>-v, --volumes</code> | Refused: see the message it prints |
| <code>-p, --project-name &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Project name (default: the project directory's name, normalized) |
| <code>--remove-orphans</code> | Accepted for compatibility: `down` removes everything labelled with the project, so an orphan is removed either way |
| <code>--project-directory &lt;DIR&gt;</code> | Directory `env_file` paths and the default project name come from |

## `satl compose ps` { #satl-compose-ps }

List the tasks of the project's services

```console
$ satl compose ps [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-f, --file &lt;FILE&gt;</code> | Compose file to read; found by walking up from the working directory when not given |
| <code>--no-trunc</code> | Don't truncate output |
| <code>-p, --project-name &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Project name (default: the project directory's name, normalized) |
| <code>-q, --quiet</code> | Only display task IDs |
| <code>--project-directory &lt;DIR&gt;</code> | Directory `env_file` paths and the default project name come from |

## `satl compose config` { #satl-compose-config }

Print what `up` would create, without creating it

```console
$ satl compose config [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>-f, --file &lt;FILE&gt;</code> | Compose file to read; found by walking up from the working directory when not given |
| <code>-q, --quiet</code> | Only validate the file; print nothing |
| <code>-p, --project-name &lt;NAME&gt;</code> | Project name (default: the project directory's name, normalized) |
| <code>--project-directory &lt;DIR&gt;</code> | Directory `env_file` paths and the default project name come from |

## Global options { #global-options }

Accepted by every `satl` command.

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <code>--host &lt;URL&gt;</code> | Daemon socket to connect to (docker-style URL)<br>Default: <code>unix:///var/run/satl.sock</code><br>Environment: <code>DOCKER_HOST</code> |
| <code>-h, --help</code> | Print help |
| <code>-V, --version</code> | Print version |
